summary: NDPS Act conviction; conscious possession challenged; FIR based on informer's tip; search at railway station without warrant; panchnamas recorded; appellant claimed false implication; courts upheld conviction based on reliable information and procedural compliance; standard of preponderance applied; benefit of doubt not warranted; challenge to search procedure rejected.
legal_provisions_cited: Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances Act, 1985 s.8
Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances Act, 1985 s.15
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; conviction and sentence upheld.
